story_text: As a user, I want to update the title of an existing task so that I can correct or clarify it.

positive.title: Update title with a valid new value
steps: 1. Create a new task with an initial title.
2. Update the task's title to a new valid value.
3. Retrieve the task details to verify the update.

positive.title: Update title and verify change persists
steps: 1. Create a new task with an initial title.
2. Update the task's title to a new valid value.
3. Retrieve the task details to verify the update.
positive.expected_result: Title matches the updated value exactly

negative.title: Update title with an empty string
steps: 1. Create a new task with an initial title.
2. Attempt to update the task's title to an empty string.
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · title cannot be empty

negative.title: Update title of a non-existent task
steps: 1. Attempt to update the title of a task that does not exist.
negative.expected_result: 404 Not Found · task does not exist

negative.title: Update title of another user's task
steps: 1. Attempt to update the title of a task owned by another user.
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · title contains prohibited characters

negative.title: Update title without authentication
steps: 1. Attempt to update the title of a task without providing authentication.

edge.title: Update title with maximum allowed characters
steps: 1. Create a new task with an initial title.
2. Update the task's title to the maximum allowed number of characters.
3. Retrieve the task details to verify the update.
edge.expected_result: 200 OK · full title stored without truncation
